description: Quickly check up to 10 candidate app, product or startup names. For each name it reports whether the .com and .app domains are registered (and, for a taken .com, what business or page is on it), whether an app with that name is on the US App Store or Google Play, and whether the GitHub name and npm package are taken. Use it on every name before suggesting it. Takes about 5 to 30 seconds.

names.description: Candidate names, e.g. ["pawtrail", "leashly"]. Spaces are removed; letters, numbers and hyphens only.

name: screen_names
title: Screen name ideas
